title.en: Microsoft packs96 AI chips into167kilowatts. Can its2027 promise pay off?
title.zh: 微软把96颗AI芯片装进167千瓦：2027年的承诺能兑现吗？

summary.en: Maia200 is in production; Maia300 is planned for2027. Reported efficiency gains are Microsoft claims, not independently reproduced results.
summary.zh: Maia200已投产，Maia300计划2027年部署。效率提升为微软披露，未独立复验。

title.en: Meta spent14months rebuilding itsAI effort. Now it wants an agent that remembers you.
title.zh: Meta重建AI十四个月，现在要让智能体记住你。

summary.en: MuseWonder launches through developer channels; wider Muse rollout is pending. Memory and task persistence remain vendor capabilities, not evidence of universal reliability.
summary.zh: MuseWonder先进入开发者渠道，更广Muse上线尚待。记忆与任务坚持是厂商能力主张，非普遍可靠性证明。
